SNA.fact: Passenger volume is capped by the 1985 Settlement Agreement (amended 2014): 11.8 million annual passengers through 2025, and 12.2 or 12.5 million for 2026-2030 depending on conditions. The agreement runs through December 31, 2030.
A night curfew limits operations; under the 2014 amendment the County must maintain and enforce it through 2035.
Night hours: departures 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. (8 a.m. Sunday), arrivals 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. (8 a.m. Sunday).

SFO.fact: SFO's parallel runways are only 750 feet apart. In low visibility (e.g. fog), FAA rules allow side-by-side arrivals only on runways at least 4,300 feet apart, so arrivals go single-file and the arrival rate drops to about 30 per hour, requiring a Ground Delay Program.

In 2026 the FAA stopped side-by-side parallel arrivals at SFO; staggered arrivals are now allowed in good weather (reported up to about 42 per hour), below the rate the airport handled with parallel landings.
In BTS delay data, non-extreme weather that slows operations (such as fog) is reported as a National Aviation System (NAS) delay, not as 'extreme weather'.

ANC.fact: Ted Stevens Anchorage International is ranked the #1 cargo airport in the U.S. and #3 in the world (Airports Council International World rankings, April 2026 release).

Its location on the great-circle route between Asia and North America lets aircraft reach nearly 90% of the industrialized world within 9.5 hours; it is a hub for transpacific cargo, refueling, crew changes and technical stops.

BOS.fact: Massport describes Logan's main constraint as its geographically limited footprint: a campus of about 2,400 acres, one of the nation's smallest major airports.
The Terminal E (international gateway) expansion was approved as reusing space already in aviation use, without expanding the airport footprint.

HVN.fact: In 2021 Avelo Airlines made Tweed New Haven its first East Coast base, under a privately financed plan (Avports 43-year lease, over $100 million) for a new terminal and a longer runway. This explains the jump in traffic from a very small base.
The 5,600-foot runway caps Avelo's 737-800 loads at 162 passengers; the FAA approved a 975-foot extension, reported to start construction in late 2026.

LAX.fact: LAX's $3.3 billion Automated People Mover, meant to ease access to the terminal area, has been repeatedly delayed; passenger service was reported for early January 2027 at the earliest.
